Includes conditional E.C.-furnished detector access door. summary: These six sheets are mechanical schedules, details, demolition plans and new-work plans with electrical and controls coordination requirements. The electrical-related work includes five thermostat sensor relocations with replacement conduit and wiring, two new terminal-box sensor installations, six new smoke/fire dampers, and removal of one existing smoke/fire damper. The damper detail assigns junction boxes, fire alarm signaling wiring and addressable control-module wiring to the electrical contractor, with certain smoke-control wiring assigned to the temperature controls contractor. Two new terminal boxes have hydronic reheat; no electrical voltage, load or circuit data is supplied for their controls or for the damper operators. Existing terminal boxes and numerous smoke/fire dampers remain, with verification, maintenance and recommissioning requirements. No electrical feeders, panel schedules or dimensioned electrical raceway routes appear on these pages.
